admin.ops_tools.guide_push_2.source: 2. We POST to their HTTPS address

admin.email.guide_log_what.source: The shop writes the full message into the server log (storage/logs/laravel.log) and stops. The address in Send to does not receive anything.

admin.email.guide_log_when.source: Use this on a computer where you only want to check a template before a mailbox is ready.

admin.email.guide_log_fill.source: Set Mailer to Log (local). From name and From email are saved for later. Host, port, username, and password are ignored.

admin.email.guide_log_check.source: Send a test. The page can say it was sent, and Email logs shows Sent, because the log file was written. The inbox stays empty. Open the log file to read the message.

admin.email.guide_smtp_what.source: The shop signs in to a mail host and delivers the message. This is the option that works on this computer and on a server when you have a mailbox.

admin.email.guide_smtp_fill.source: Set Mailer to SMTP. From email should be a mailbox that host lets you send from, and it usually must match the username. From name is what the customer sees.

admin.email.guide_smtp_server.source: Host is the provider’s SMTP server, for example smtp.hostinger.com. Use port 465 with SSL, or port 587 with TLS. Username is usually the full email address. Password is that mailbox password. Leave the password blank to keep the one already saved.

admin.email.guide_smtp_check.source: Send a test to an inbox you can open. Mailer, host, and from-address save as you edit them. The password saves when you leave that field. If the test does not arrive, open Email logs on this page. The host’s error is stored there (wrong password, blocked port, or a From address the host refused).

admin.email.guide_sendmail_what.source: The shop hands the message to the mail program already installed on the server. PHP’s sendmail_path is used, so you do not enter a host, port, or password.

admin.email.guide_sendmail_server.source: It works on a Linux server where sendmail or Postfix is installed, or where the host has set sendmail_path in php.ini. After you move the shop there, choose Sendmail and send a test.

admin.email.guide_sendmail_local.source: This Windows computer has no sendmail program. A test here will fail and tell you to use SMTP. That is expected. SMTP is the option for this machine.

admin.email.guide_sendmail_fill.source: Set Mailer to Sendmail, then fill in From email and From name. Host and password stay unused. If the live server refuses the message, Email logs shows the error. Ask the host to enable local mail, or switch the shop back to SMTP.

admin.email.guide_subtitle.source: Three mailers. Pick one, save, then send a test. Only one mailer is active at a time.

admin.email.smtp_promo_title.source: Send better emails for a better experience

admin.email.smtp_promo_hint.source: Configure your SMTP settings to ensure reliable email delivery for order updates, customer notifications, and more.

admin.email.smtp_guide_hint.source: Need help? Check out our email configuration guide.

admin.email.smtp_hint.source: Choose how the shop sends emails. Password is write-only and is never shown again.

admin.email.mailer_hint.source: Use local log for testing or configure an external SMTP server.

admin.email.from_address_hint.source: This email will be used as the sender address.

admin.email.from_name_hint.source: This name will appear as the sender name in emails.

admin.email.smtp_server_hint.source: Host, port, encryption, and the mailbox login. These are required when Mailer is SMTP.

admin.email.password_set.source: A password is already stored. Leave blank to keep it.

admin.email.sendmail_ready.source: Sendmail hands each message to the mail program on this server. Host, port, and password are not used. Send a test when From email is filled in.

admin.email.sendmail_missing.source: Sendmail hands each message to the mail program on the server. This computer does not have that program, so use SMTP here. On the live Linux server, choose Sendmail after sendmail or Postfix is installed.

admin.email.log_only.source: Log (local) writes the message to the shop log. It does not deliver email. Use SMTP or Sendmail when a customer should receive the message.

admin.email.send_test_hint.source: Send a test email to verify your SMTP configuration. Mail settings save as you edit them.

admin.email.test_to_hint.source: Address that receives the test message.

admin.email.templates_lead.source: Manage the email notifications that will be sent to customers or to the store email. Customize the content using templates.

admin.email.smtp_lead.source: Manage how your store sends emails. Configure SMTP settings and send a test email to ensure everything works correctly.

admin.advanced.email_logs_lead.source: View the history of all emails sent from your store.

admin.email.lead.source: Configure the email notifications that will be sent to customers or to the store email. Forgot-password recovery cannot be turned off.

admin.email.edit_lead.source: Customize the content and design of this email template. Use variables to personalize your messages.

admin.email.template_details_hint.source: Set the basic information and variables for this template.

admin.email.template_name_hint.source: A short name to identify this template.

admin.email.subject_line_hint.source: This will be shown in the email subject line.

admin.email.insert_email_hint.source: Click a variable to drop it into the email. Select a text block first to add it there.

admin.email.insert_subject_hint.source: Click a variable to add it to the subject line.

admin.email.enabled_hint.source: This template is active and can be used.

admin.email.email_design_hint.source: Open Blocks to add a title or paragraph, then click Save template. Inbox clients receive the saved HTML.

admin.email.save_to_keep.source: Click Save template to keep this design. Editing the canvas does not save on its own.

admin.advanced.search_email_logs.source: Search by email, subject, or template...

admin.advanced.no_email_logs_hint.source: Sends from templates, events, and SMTP tests appear here.

admin.advanced.about_email_logs_hint.source: This page records outgoing store emails so you can troubleshoot delivery and template issues.

admin.advanced.need_help_email_hint.source: Check the documentation for SMTP setup and email templates.

admin.gdpr.subtitle.source: Customer data requests, the signup agreement, and the cookie notice. Titles follow the language you pick. Page text comes from the CMS page in the shopper language.

admin.gdpr.compliance_hint.source: Customers see GDPR Requests in their account only while this is on.

admin.gdpr.enabled_hint.source: Turns on GDPR Requests, the customer agreement, and the cookie notice.

admin.gdpr.agreement_hint.source: The title is the checkbox sentence. The CMS page is what Click Here opens.

admin.gdpr.agreement_enabled_hint.source: Shows the agreement checkbox on the sign-up form.

admin.gdpr.needs_page.source: Create a page under Design, then choose it here.

admin.gdpr.agreement_page_hint.source: The language menu sets the title and the CMS page together.

admin.gdpr.cookie_notice_hint.source: The title is the notice heading. The CMS page is the cookie text.

admin.gdpr.cookie_notice_enabled_hint.source: Shows Accept, Reject, and Learn More and Customize.

admin.gdpr.cookie_page_hint.source: The language menu sets the title and the CMS page together.

admin.gdpr.cookie_preferences_hint.source: Short description beside each choice. The language menu applies to every description.

admin.search_shortcut.hint.source: Opens the search bar from any admin page. Pick a modifier and a key, then save. It works on the next page right away.

admin.store.cannot_disable.source: Turn off extra shops before disabling multishop.

admin.store.enable_hint.source: Stay on one shop until you need another URL, catalog, or brand.

admin.store.multivendor_hint.source: Enable marketplace features, seller management, seller portal, seller catalog and multi-vendor commerce functionality.

admin.store.contact_form_hint.source: Allow shoppers to send a message to the webmaster or support team.

admin.store.sms_otp_hint.source: After password, send a one-time code to the customer phone. Codes are logged until you set a webhook.

admin.store.login_email_password_hint.source: Classic sign-in. Keep at least one sign-in method on.

admin.store.login_mobile_password_hint.source: Shoppers sign in with their verified mobile number and password.

admin.store.login_mobile_otp_hint.source: Passwordless sign-in with a texted code. Needs an SMS provider below.

admin.general.subtitle.source: Turn store features on or off. Related menus stay hidden until a feature is enabled.

admin.general.admin_address_hint.source: Replace the word admin in the address. The rest of the admin stays the same.

admin.store.store_features_hint.source: Enable or disable features for your store

admin.store.sms_not_configured.source: Mobile sign-in is on but no SMS provider is configured yet. Codes will only be logged until you add one.

admin.store.sms_provider_hint.source: Log codes while testing, then switch to a webhook or Twilio for real texts.

admin.store.sms_webhook_hint.source: POST JSON {to, body, purpose} to this URL. Leave blank to log codes only.

admin.store.sms_twilio_hint.source: Find these in your Twilio console. The token is stored secretly and never shown again.

admin.store.otp_policy_hint.source: How long codes stay valid, how many tries are allowed, and how fast a new code can be requested.

admin.store.features_note.source: You can change these settings anytime. Disabling a feature will hide related menus and functionality.

admin.store.cookies_hint.source: How long staff and shoppers stay signed in while idle. Values are in minutes.

admin.store.cookie_bo_hint.source: How long staff stay signed in while idle. 12 hours is the longest.

admin.store.cookie_fo_hint.source: How long shoppers stay signed in while idle. 7 days is the longest.

admin.images.tip_square.source: Use square images for consistent display.

admin.images.tip_small.source: Keep file sizes small for faster loading.

admin.images.tip_webp.source: Use WebP format for better performance.

admin.images.subtitle.source: Manage uploaded image sizes and thumbnail generation settings for your store.

admin.images.sizes_hint.source: Set the maximum dimensions for images used throughout your store.

admin.images.gd_missing.source: PHP GD is not available, so thumbnails cannot be generated on this server.

admin.images.webp_hint.source: Falls back to JPEG when WebP is not supported.

admin.images.webp_note.source: WebP images are smaller and faster, improving your store performance.

admin.images.regenerate_hint.source: Re-writes sized files for every product image. Use missing only to skip images that already have every type.

admin.images.about_body.source: These settings control the maximum size for uploaded images. The system creates resized copies for different pages. Cover-required-before-publish lives under Product Settings.

admin.inventory_settings.enabled_hint.source: On: each sale checks quantity and reduces it. Off: orders do not change stock.

admin.inventory_settings.negative_hint.source: Storefront and checkout can still sell after quantity hits zero. The saved quantity can go below zero.

admin.inventory_settings.notifications_h.source: The admin bell rings when a tracked product hits its low-stock level. The store email gets the same notice on the hourly check.

admin.inventory_settings.scope_warehouse.source: Global always takes stock from the default warehouse. Warehouse takes it from the location that has enough quantity.

admin.inventory_settings.product_link.source: Low-stock alert, out-of-stock behavior, and backorders: Product Settings.

admin.inventory_settings.order_link.source: Deduct at order/payment/processing, unpaid reservation, restore on cancel: Order Settings.

admin.inventory_settings.subtitle.source: Store-wide stock engine. Product pages own product defaults. Orders own deduction timing.

admin.order_settings.subtitle.source: Store-wide order, checkout, stock, and notification behavior.

admin.order_settings.panel_defaults_hint.source: Order numbers, starting sequence, default status, and order totals.

admin.order_settings.number_format_hint.source: Editable. A valid format is saved and used on the next order. Include {number} once. Example: ORD-{number}

admin.order_settings.number_start_hint.source: Changing this sets the next order to this number. A number already used is skipped. Later orders continue upward.

admin.order_settings.default_status_hint.source: Enabled statuses for this shop. A new order starts in the one you pick.

admin.order_settings.preview_number_hint.source: Read-only. The id the next order will get. A number already used is skipped.

admin.order_settings.min_amount_hint.source: 0 = no minimum. Compared to the checkout grand total.

admin.order_settings.panel_checkout_hint.source: Customer notes, guest order tracking, and cancellation. Guest checkout lives under Configure → Customers.

admin.order_settings.customer_notes_hint.source: Shoppers can leave a note at checkout.

admin.order_settings.guest_lookup_hint.source: When this is on, Track your order appears in the storefront header and footer. Guests open it and enter the order number, email, and postal code.

admin.order_settings.allow_cancellation_.source: Customers can cancel while the order is in a status before the one you pick.

admin.order_settings.panel_payment_hint.source: When stock moves, and what happens to unpaid orders.

admin.order_settings.reduce_stock_at_hin.source: Inventory is deducted when the order reaches this status. If a new order already starts there, stock is deducted at placement.

admin.order_settings.reserve_stock_hint.source: Holds the units until the order reaches the Reduce stock at status. The hold ends after this many minutes if that status never happens.

admin.order_settings.restock_on_cancel_h.source: Put reserved or deducted units back when an order is cancelled.

admin.order_settings.panel_notifications.source: Choose who is emailed when a customer places an order.

admin.order_settings.email_customer_hint.source: Email the customer when an order is placed.

admin.order_settings.email_admin_hint.source: Each address here is notified when an order is placed. Separate extra addresses with commas.

admin.performance.clear_app.source: Application cache, including settings, counts, and search

admin.performance.clear_compiled.source: Compiled pages, routes, and config cache

admin.performance.keep_assets.source: Built CSS, JavaScript, and uploaded images

admin.performance.lead.source: Settings that change how fast the shop responds. The storefront CSS and JavaScript are already combined by the React build.

admin.performance.debug_hint.source: Shows the real error on the page when something breaks. Leave it off on a public shop.

admin.performance.debug_locked_hint.source: Locked off: this shop runs in production. Use a staging copy to see full error pages.

admin.performance.debug_toggle_hint.source: On shows full errors to shoppers and staff, and makes each page slower. Off shows a plain error page.

admin.performance.debug_on.source: Debug mode is on. Shoppers can see error details. Turn it off before the shop is public.

admin.performance.debug_off.source: Debug mode is off. Shoppers do not see error details.

admin.performance.catalog_hint.source: Guest home and category pages can be reused instead of reading the database on every visit.

admin.performance.ttl_auto.source: Automatic — home about 5 minutes, category lists about 2 minutes

admin.performance.ttl_off.source: Off — read the database on every visit

admin.performance.catalog_note.source: Saving a product or category refreshes these pages at once. A longer time does not leave old prices or sold-out products on the shop. Signed-in shoppers still see their own prices immediately.

admin.performance.clear_hint.source: Use this when a setting or a compiled page looks stuck. The first visits after a clear are slower while the cache fills again.

admin.performance.assets_hint.source: The React storefront is already one build. Hashed files can stay in the browser. There is no separate combine switch, because combining them again would slow the shop down.

admin.performance.assets_missing.source: The storefront build is missing. Run npm run build so shoppers get the combined CSS and JavaScript.

admin.performance.theme_css_hint.source: Loaded in addition to the React build. One extra file does not need to be combined.

admin.performance.browser_cache.source: Apache keeps hashed CSS and JavaScript for a year, other images and styles for a day, and compresses them when the server allows it.

admin.performance.benchmark_hint.source: Real numbers from this shop and this machine. Not a marketing 10M claim.

admin.performance.benchmark_empty.source: No benchmark yet. Run one after the shop is seeded.

admin.performance.profiler_hint.source: Records time, memory, and SQL for recent requests. Leave it off on a live shop. It slows every page.

admin.performance.profiler_toggle_hint.source: Turn it on, browse the slow page, then come back. The full SQL list stays on Advanced → Profiler.

admin.performance.status_hint.source: Read from this shop. These are not switches.

admin.performance.redis_note.source: For production scale use CACHE_STORE=redis, SESSION_DRIVER=redis, QUEUE_CONNECTION=redis, and WENTO_SERVER=octane.

admin.pricing_settings.tax_hint.source: How prices are entered and shown on the storefront.

admin.pricing_settings.display_hint.source: Show prices with tax, without tax, or both.

admin.pricing_settings.decimals_hint.source: Digits after the decimal point. 0 to 4.

admin.pricing_settings.zero_hint.source: Allow, hide the price, or show contact us.

admin.pricing_settings.sale_on_hint.source: Let products use a sale price.

admin.pricing_settings.compare_at_hint.source: Show the original price next to the sale price.

admin.pricing_settings.omnibus_hint.source: Show the lowest price in the last 30 days when a product is on sale.

admin.pricing_settings.shipping_tax_hint.source: When enabled, each shipping method can use its own tax class. Shipping with no tax class is not taxed.

admin.pricing_settings.subtitle.source: How prices are entered and shown. Currencies stay under International.

admin.product_settings.subtitle.source: Global product behavior for the whole store.

admin.product_settings.panel_list_hint.source: On the admin product list, this color paints across a row when it is selected.

admin.product_settings.highlight_enabled.source: Paint a wash across selected rows on the admin product list. Turn this off to leave those rows plain.

admin.product_settings.highlight_color_h.source: Used as the selected-row wash color.

admin.product_settings.highlight_ms_hint.source: How long the left-to-right paint takes. Range: 100 to 5000.

admin.product_settings.preview_hint.source: Sample row using the current color and timing.

admin.product_settings.panel_catalog_hin.source: Shop-wide catalog mode, prices, and description length limits.

admin.product_settings.catalog_mode_hint.source: Apply storefront catalog display rules (prices and content limits).

admin.product_settings.show_price_hint.source: When off, the storefront hides product prices shop-wide.

admin.product_settings.hide_prices_guest.source: Logged-in customers still see prices. Guest catalog shows “login to see price”.

admin.product_settings.short_description.source: Plain-text character limit on product short descriptions.

admin.product_settings.description_max_h.source: Plain-text character limit on product descriptions.

admin.product_settings.panel_defaults_hi.source: Status, type, SKU, and barcode for new products.

admin.product_settings.default_status_hi.source: Status applied when a product is created.

admin.product_settings.default_type_hint.source: Pre-selected when you click New product. You can still choose another type.

admin.product_settings.sku_manual_note.source: Manual mode requires a unique SKU on every product.

admin.product_settings.barcode_mode_hint.source: Off hides the product QR and the retail codes. Optional or Required shows a QR code of the product page — scanning it opens that product. Required also blocks an active product until a UPC or GTIN is filled.

admin.product_settings.panel_inventory_h.source: Stock tracking and out-of-stock behavior for new products.

admin.product_settings.default_manage_st.source: New products count stock. At zero, Out-of-stock behavior below decides if they can still be bought or stay listed. Turn this off and quantity does not limit the product.

admin.product_settings.default_low_stock.source: Copied onto new products. When tracked stock is at or below this number, the admin product is marked low stock and the shop can email you. Customers do not see this number.

admin.product_settings.oos_behavior_hint.source: Default for new products. Allow keeps purchases open at zero stock. Do not allow keeps the product visible but blocks purchase. Hide products removes it from listings and search when out of stock.

admin.product_settings.panel_qty_hint.source: Default order quantities. Shop units come from Localization.

admin.product_settings.default_min_qty_h.source: Smallest quantity a customer can add. A product uses this when its own Min qty is empty.

admin.product_settings.default_qty_step_.source: Quantity changes in this step on the product page and in the cart. A product uses this when its own Qty step is empty.

admin.product_settings.default_max_qty_h.source: Largest quantity a customer can add. Leave empty for no shop maximum. A product uses this when its own Max qty is empty.

admin.product_settings.panel_features_hi.source: Compare, publish rules, and availability defaults.

admin.product_settings.compare_enabled_h.source: Shoppers add products from the card or product page. The header Compare icon opens the comparison.

admin.product_settings.compare_fields_hi.source: Choose which product fields appear in compare results. Product name and image always show in the comparison header. Unchecked fields stay hidden without changing compare list size.

admin.product_settings.default_available.source: New products can be purchased until you change them.

admin.product_settings.require_cover_hin.source: A product cannot go live without a cover image.

admin.product_settings.require_brand_hin.source: A product cannot go live without a brand.

admin.store.product_video_hint.source: Add a YouTube or Vimeo video to a product. Shoppers can watch it under the photos on the product page.

admin.product_settings.out_of_stock_noti.source: Allow customers to subscribe for a notification when an out-of-stock product becomes available.

admin.return_settings.enabled_hint.source: Customers can request a return from their order.

admin.return_settings.window_hint.source: Days after the order that a return can be opened. 0 means no limit.

admin.return_settings.reason_hint.source: The customer must give a reason.

admin.return_settings.approval_hint.source: Required waits for a staff decision. Automatic accepts the return as soon as the customer sends it.

admin.return_settings.partial_hint.source: Allow returning some lines from an order.

admin.return_settings.method_hint.source: A credit slip records the refund on the order. A voucher is a one-use coupon the customer can spend later.

admin.return_settings.ship_cost_hint.source: Yes adds the original shipping charge to the refund. No leaves it out.

admin.return_settings.restock_hint.source: Automatic puts the units back in stock when the return is refunded. Manual leaves stock unchanged so you can edit it yourself.

admin.return_settings.fee_hint.source: When this is on, that percent of the returned item total is taken off the refund. Stock is not changed by this fee.

admin.return_settings.subtitle.source: Global return policy. Order cancellation stays on Order Settings.

admin.review_settings.policy_hint.source: Who may review products and whether staff must approve them.

admin.review_settings.enabled_hint.source: Shoppers can leave a rating on a product.

admin.review_settings.who_everyone_hint.source: Guests can review without an account. Signed-in customers can review too.

admin.review_settings.who_verified_hint.source: Only a signed-in customer who bought this product can review it.

admin.review_settings.who_registered_hin.source: Only a signed-in customer can review. Guests are asked to sign in.

admin.review_settings.mod_auto_hint.source: Publish the review as soon as it is submitted. It appears on the product page immediately.

admin.review_settings.mod_required_hint.source: Hold the review until a staff member approves it under Customers → Reviews. Shoppers do not see it before then.

admin.review_settings.replies_hint.source: Staff write the reply on Customers → Reviews. It shows under the review on the product page. A customer cannot reply as staff, even when their email matches an employee.

admin.review_settings.min_hint.source: The written review cannot be longer than this. A longer review is rejected. 0 hides the title and review text and leaves the star rating.

admin.review_settings.subtitle.source: Who may review products and whether staff must approve them. Review records stay under Customers.

admin.search_catalog.sort_hint.source: Order used when a shopper has not chosen a sort.

admin.search_catalog.suggestions_hint.source: Offer matching terms as the shopper types.

admin.search_catalog.typo_hint.source: Still find products when the query has a small typo.

admin.search_catalog.engines_hint.source: Pick the preferred engine. Unavailable engines fall through automatically.

admin.search_catalog.preferred_engine_hi.source: Meilisearch and Elasticsearch need a host. Database always works.

admin.search_catalog.meilisearch_on_hint.source: Falls back when the host is empty or unreachable.

admin.search_catalog.meilisearch_key_hin.source: Search or admin key from your Meilisearch instance.

admin.search_catalog.meilisearch_index_h.source: Index name on the Meilisearch server.

admin.search_catalog.wishlist_hint.source: Let shoppers save products for later.

admin.search_catalog.compare_note.source: Product comparison is configured on Product Settings.

admin.search_catalog.synonyms_hint.source: Expand a search term to aliases (comma-separated).

admin.search_catalog.pins_hint.source: Pin a product to the top of page 1 for an exact search query.

admin.search_catalog.redirects_hint.source: Send a search term to a category or page path, e.g. /catalog/shoes.

admin.search_catalog.subtitle.source: Storefront listing and discovery. Compare lives on Product Settings. Out-of-stock visibility is also owned there.

admin.seo.tip_meta.source: Write unique meta descriptions for key pages.

admin.seo.tip_og.source: Add an Open Graph image for social sharing.

admin.seo.tip_sitemap.source: Keep sitemap.xml enabled for search engines.

admin.seo.token_name.source: Replaced with the current page name.

admin.seo.all_clear.source: No open SEO or store issues. Keep titles unique as you add products.

admin.seo.settings_hint.source: Configure how your store appears in search engines and social media.

admin.seo.title_pattern_hint.source: Used when a page has no SEO title. Tokens: {name}, {shop}.

admin.seo.product_title_pattern_hint.source: Optional override for product pages only. Leave blank to use the default pattern.

admin.seo.default_description_hint.source: Used when a page has no meta description.

admin.seo.default_robots_hint.source: Default robots meta tag for all pages.

admin.seo.locale_url_mode_hint.source: Path (/en/…, /fr/…) is required for full multilingual SEO (distinct home URLs, sitemap alternates). Cookie mode is fine for a single language; with multiple languages, entity hreflang still uses per-language rewrite paths.

admin.seo.locale_path.source: Path prefix (/en, /fr) — recommended for multilingual SEO

admin.seo.og_image_hint.source: Square image (at least 1200 x 630 px) used when a page is shared on social media.

admin.seo.sitemap_hint.source: Generate and include sitemap.xml for search engines.

admin.seo.short_fallback.source: Use short description when meta description is empty

admin.seo.short_fallback_hint.source: Product (and brand) pages fall back to short description before the shop default.

admin.seo.cookie_consent.source: Ask for cookie consent before loading pixels

admin.seo.cookie_consent_hint.source: Pixels load only after the visitor accepts cookies.

admin.seo.age_gate_hint.source: Ask visitors to confirm they are old enough before browsing.

admin.seo.admin_mfa.source: Require authenticator app for admin sign-in

admin.seo.admin_mfa_hint.source: Staff without TOTP are sent to enroll after password. Staff who already enrolled must enter a code.

admin.seo.customer_mfa.source: Prompt customers to enroll an authenticator app

admin.seo.customer_mfa_hint.source: Customers can enroll TOTP from their account. When required, sign-in asks them to set it up.

admin.seo.robots_txt_hint.source: Use {sitemap} for the shop sitemap URL.

admin.seo.about_body.source: These settings improve how your store appears in search results and when shared on social media.

admin.seo.preview_body.source: Open the storefront to check titles, meta tags, and social previews.

admin.seo.studio_subtitle.source: Store health, search listings, sitemap, and one-click fixes. No extra SEO app required.

admin.seo.scores_disclaimer.source: These scores are store health checks (meta, sitemap, indexing hygiene). They are not Google rankings or Merchant Center approval.

admin.seo.issues_hint.source: Every check the shop runs. Fix fills missing titles, descriptions, keywords, alts, and sitemap flags.

admin.seo.sitemap_files_hint.source: Submit these URLs in Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster. Large catalogs split into a sitemap index.

admin.seo.sitemap_note.source: The map lists enabled products, categories, CMS pages, and brands only. Disabled products stay out. Use Settings to change what is included.

admin.health.fix_live_hint.source: You can keep using admin. Progress stays in the header.

admin.health.fix_live_done_hint.source: This summary hides in a few seconds. Each run stays in History.

admin.store.store_url_hint.source: Set when the shop was installed. It cannot be changed here.

admin.store.shop_information_hint.source: Legal and contact details. Only the store name can differ by language.

admin.store.business_number_hint.source: GST, VAT, CIN, or other registration number. Shown on invoices and, if enabled, the footer.

admin.store.address_hint.source: Shown as one block on the footer when enabled.

admin.urls.help_product.source: Product pages. {rewrite} is the product slug, {id} the product ID, {category} and {id_category} the default category, and {ipa} a variant.

admin.urls.help_category.source: Category pages. {rewrite} is the category slug, {id} its ID, and {parent} and {id_parent} the parent category.

admin.urls.help_cms.source: CMS pages. {rewrite} is the page slug and {id} the page ID. A prefix such as content/ groups those pages.

admin.urls.help_brand.source: Brand pages. brand/{rewrite} keeps every brand under /brand/. {id} adds the brand ID.

admin.urls.help_supplier.source: Supplier pages. supplier/{rewrite} keeps every supplier under /supplier/. {id} adds the supplier ID.

admin.urls.tip_keywords.source: Include relevant keywords in the slug ({rewrite}).

admin.urls.tip_chars.source: Avoid special characters; use hyphens between words.

admin.urls.tip_regenerate.source: Changes apply as you edit. Earlier addresses keep working as redirects.

admin.urls.subtitle.source: Manage SEO-friendly URLs for products, categories, CMS pages and more. Customize the structure and regenerate URLs when needed.

admin.urls.seo_warning.source: Changing these addresses changes the URLs search engines already know. The old address keeps working as a redirect, but rankings can still move.

admin.urls.schemas_hint.source: Choose how public paths are built. {rewrite} is the slug on the product, category, or page form.

admin.urls.suffix_hint.source: Optional ending appended to every generated path (for example .html).

admin.shipping.shown_to_the_customer_at_.source: Shown to the customer at checkout

admin.shipping.added_to_the_order_as_shi.source: Added to the order as shipping charges.

admin.shipping.tax_class_none.source: No tax on this shipping method

admin.shipping.carrier_sandbox_hint.source: Uses the built-in sandbox carrier until you install a live FedEx or DHL extension.

admin.shipping.shipping_fee_is_0_use_con.source: Shipping fee is 0. Use conditions to require a minimum order if needed.

admin.shipping.conditions_hint.source: Order value, weight, and customer group limits are optional. Leave them empty to allow every order.

admin.shipping.zone_explain.source: Zones live under International. Each country belongs to one zone. Choose the zones this method delivers to. Leave this empty to offer it in every country.

admin.shipping.no_zones_on_method.source: No shipping zones yet. This method ships to every country until you create one and select it.
